message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have communicated the situation to Brad. Now, as I stated in my reasoning and in my message to Brad, the correct course of action is to report that the meeting cannot be scheduled. I have confirmed that there is no overlap in the schedules.Based on a thorough comparison of the calendars, there are no 30-minute time slots available next week for all four partners to meet. I have cross-referenced the available slots for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale with the available slots for Elena Soto and David Okafor (as provided by my colleague, Brad), and there is no common availability.
